label: LP-700 WebSocket
info:
LP-500 / LP-700 telemetry & control via the lp700-server WebSocket gateway.

Replaces the direct USB-HID nodes used by KD4Z's `LP Dice and Slice` reference flow with a websocket client pointed at the lp700-server's `/ws` endpoint. Output `msg.payload` shape on the link-out `lp700-telemetry` is identical to the original (`power_avg`, `power_peak`, `swr`, `scale`, `mode`, `channel`, `range`) so any downstream nodes from the original flow keep working unchanged.

Setup:
  1. Edit the `lp700-server` websocket-client config node and set `URL` to your Pi (e.g. `ws://raspberrypi.local:8089/ws`).
  2. Deploy.
  3. Wire the `lp700-telemetry` link-out into your existing dashboard / Peak-Hold / range-label nodes (the link-in `lp700-telemetry` matches by name).

See README.md in this directory for migration details.

name: INBOUND  ─  lp700-server  →  Node-RED
info: Receives telemetry, heartbeat, ack, and status frames over /ws. Telemetry is reshaped to KD4Z-compatible keys and re-emitted on the `lp700-telemetry` link.

OUTBOUND  ─  Node-RED  →  lp700-server
info:
Inject buttons emit JSON `{type:'command', action:'…'}` frames. The lp700-server forwards them into its single-writer HID OUT queue and an `ack` frame returns on the inbound side.

Verbs: mode_step · channel_step · range_step · alarm_toggle · peak_toggle · setup · freeze
